method: Claude desktop built-in browser (Chromium 156, macOS), viewport 817x1602 @2x, real network (navigator.connection: 4g, ~10 Mbps, ~100 ms RTT). Navigation/Resource/Paint timing APIs read after load; fonts may have been warm in cache.

findings: Navigation landmark contains 4 links with no accessible name and no href (not focusable).
LinkedIn and GitHub links have no accessible name.
Company arrow links (Copilot, Ping Identity, MURAL, Incentrik) have no accessible name.
"Contact Me" is exposed as a button, not a link.
Experience counters are exposed as "yrs" with no number (the number is rendered by CountUp only while in view).
Several tech-stack SVG icons are exposed as unnamed images next to their text label (decorative icons not hidden).

Heading outline: h1 Garrett Head; h2 About me; h3 Senior Software Engineer; h2 Experience; h3 Senior Software Engineer; h3 Bachelor's in Computer Science; per role two headings (title, "Company - duration"); then "Let's Geaux!" before h2 "Contact me".
Form fields are named only by their placeholders (Your name, Your email, Your message); email field is type=text.
Sections are exposed as unnamed regions; no main, header or footer landmarks.

notRun: Automated axe-core scan of the live page: injecting the third-party axe script into the live site was not permitted in this session. Equivalent DOM checks were run locally (lab.json domA11y) and contrast was sampled from rendered pixels (contrast.json).
